title: Safehouse and Protocol
author: Silas Nystrom
blurb: Xanthe Iversen, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
